description: Clean web reader for AI agents. Card API key or x402 wallet pay-per-call. Free tier included.
name: io.github.JessieJanie/skim402

environmentVariables.description: Card plan API key — easiest way to get started. Get one free at https://skim402.com/pricing. Unlocks higher rate limits without a crypto wallet.
environmentVariables.name: SKIM_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Wallet pay alternative: Base-network private key (0x-prefixed). Fund with a small USDC balance on Base to pay $0.002 per read call via x402. Use SKIM_API_KEY instead if you prefer a card plan.
environmentVariables.name: SKIM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional cap on per-call price in USD (default 0.01). Requests priced above this are rejected before payment.
environmentVariables.name: SKIM_MAX_PRICE_USD
